title: ProAR: Learning Prospective Reasoning with Autoregressive Video Models
title_zh: ProAR: 学习前瞻性推理与自回归视频模型

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive (AR) video models excel at causal generation, but their reliance on next-chunk prediction confines them to a short-sighted, reactive paradigm. This limitation is particularly consequential for reasoning-oriented generation, where achieving a target outcome through valid intermediate states matters more than local visual plausibility. To address this challenge, we propose Learning Pro spective Reasoning with A uto r egressive Video Models (ProAR) , a novel framework that transforms autoregressive video generation into a goal-oriented reasoning process. ProAR introduces two key components: (1) To anchor generation to the long-range outcome , we integrate goal-frame prediction into the autoregressive loop via an asymmetric attention mask, enabling the predicted goal frame to guide the generation of intermediate states without being disrupted by them. (2) To guide short-range transition , we introduce future representation self-alignment to encourage current hidden states to anticipate upcoming temporal dynamics. By leveraging teacher-forcing in AR training, we extract clean future representations in a single forward pass and align current representations with them using a lightweight, training-only predictor. Together, these two mechanisms seamlessly combine explicit, sparse target supervision with implicit, dense step-wise guidance, promoting coherent, goal-directed reasoning progress with modest computational cost. Experiments show that ProAR’s complementary components consistently improve performance across diverse visual reasoning benchmarks. The framework proves highly training-efficient, surpassing fully trained standard AR baselines using only 25% of the training steps. This paradigm also demonstrates promising applicability to embodied reasoning tasks. Project Page: https://luka-group.github.io/ProAR/
paragraphs.zh: 自回归（AR）视频模型在因果生成方面表现优异，但其对下一片段预测的依赖使其局限于一种短视且被动的范式。 这种局限性对于以推理为导向的生成尤为重要，因为通过有效的中间状态达成目标结果比局部视觉上的合理性更为关键。 为应对这一挑战，我们提出了“基于自回归视频模型的前瞻性推理学习”（ProAR），这是一种新颖的框架，它将自回归视频生成转化为一个以目标为导向的推理过程。 ProAR 引入了两个关键组件：（1）为了将生成过程锚定到长期目标结果上，我们通过非对称注意力掩码将目标帧预测整合到自回归循环中，使预测的目标帧能够指导中间状态的生成，而不会受到这些中间状态的干扰。 （2）为了引导短期过渡，我们引入了未来表示自我对齐机制，以促使当前隐藏状态能够预判即将到来的时间动态变化。 通过在 AR 训练中利用教师强制法，我们可以在单次前向传播中提取纯净的未来表示，并使用一个仅用于训练的轻量级预测器将当前表示与这些未来表示对齐。 这两种机制共同作用，无缝地结合了显式、稀疏的目标监督与隐式、密集的分步引导，从而以适度的计算成本促进了连贯且以目标为导向的推理进程。 实验表明，ProAR 的互补组件在各种视觉推理基准测试中均能持续提升性能。 该框架展现出极高的训练效率，仅需使用 25% 的训练步数即可超越完全训练的标准 AR 基线模型。 这一范式在具身推理任务中也展现出良好的应用前景。 项目页面：https://luka-group.github.io/ProAR/

paragraphs.en: Video generation models are moving beyond visual synthesis toward reasoning through visual dynamics. They have been used to solve game-like problems such as maze navigation and visual puzzles ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Xu et al., 2026b ; Zhu et al., 2026b ) , simulate physical processes ( Yao et al., 2026 ) , and support embodied control ( Bruce et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2026c ; He et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026c ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . In these settings, the generated video is itself the reasoning process: the model must achieve a target outcome by generating a sequence of valid visual states. This paradigm requires video models to reason about and plan the evolution of visual states, rather than merely produce visually plausible content, opening new possibilities for physical and embodied intelligence ( Kataoka et al., 2026 ) . We refer to this emerging paradigm as video-native reasoning , where a model reasons by directly generating how the visual world evolves.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成模型正在超越视觉合成，转向通过视觉动态进行推理。 它们已被用于解决类似游戏的问题，例如迷宫导航和视觉谜题（Wang 等，2026a；Xu 等，2026b；Zhu 等，2026b），模拟物理过程（Yao 等，2026），以及支持具身控制（Bruce 等，2024；Zhu 等，2026c；He 等，2025；Wang 等，2026c；Ye 等，2026；Li 等，2026）。 在这些场景中，生成的视频本身就是推理过程：模型必须通过生成一系列有效的视觉状态来实现目标结果。 这种范式要求视频模型对视觉状态的演变进行推理和规划，而不仅仅是生成视觉上令人信服的内容，从而为物理和具身智能开辟了新的可能性（Kataoka 等，2026）。 我们将这一新兴范式称为“视频原生推理”，即模型通过直接生成视觉世界的演变过程来进行推理。

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive (AR) video models provide a natural foundation for video-native reasoning. Unlike bidirectional video models, AR models generate video sequentially, conditioning each new chunk on the preceding visual history. This causal generation process supports long-horizon generation and low-latency streaming ( Teng et al., 2025 ; Yin et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025a ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026a ) , making AR models particularly suitable for real-time and interactive applications ( Teng et al., 2025 ; Yin et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025a ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 自回归（AR）视频模型为视频原生推理提供了天然的基础。 与双向视频模型不同，AR 模型以序列方式生成视频，每个新的视频片段都基于前面的视觉历史进行条件生成。 这种因果生成过程支持长时程生成和低延迟流式传输（Teng et al., 2025 ; Yin et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025a ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026a），使得 AR 模型特别适合实时和交互式应用（Teng et al., 2025 ; Yin et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025a ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026a）。

paragraphs.en: However, there is a fundamental mismatch between the standard AR training objective and reasoning-oriented generation. Next-chunk prediction optimizes only for locally plausible continuations of the observed history without accounting for their impact on eventual task completion, influencing all subsequent predictions. Consequently, short-sighted decisions compound over time, easily steering a locally plausible trajectory away from the intended goal (Fig. 1 (a)). Existing methods primarily focus on improving visual quality, temporal consistency, or prediction horizon ( Yu et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026a ; Qian et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026 ) , rather than explicitly addressing the short-sightedness of AR generation in goal-directed reasoning tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，标准的 AR 训练目标与面向推理的生成之间存在根本性的不匹配。 下一片段预测仅针对已观察历史中局部合理的延续进行优化，而未考虑这些延续对最终任务完成的影响，而这种影响会波及所有后续预测。 因此，短视的决策会随时间累积，轻易使一条局部合理的轨迹偏离预期目标（图 1 (a)）。 现有方法主要关注提升视觉质量、时间一致性或预测范围（Yu et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026a ; Qian et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026），而非明确解决 AR 生成在目标导向推理任务中的短视问题。

paragraphs.en: We argue that autoregressive video-native reasoning requires a prospective view of generation. We define prospective reasoning as the capacity to anticipate possible future outcomes and state transitions based on observed history, and to use this foresight to guide ongoing generation. This perspective exposes two complementary requirements (Fig. 1 (b)). At the long-range level, the model should anticipate its target outcome. At the short-range level, it should anticipate upcoming transitions that drive meaningful progress. Long-range outcome awareness provides global direction, while short-range transition awareness encourages coherent and steady progress toward the goal. Together, they enable future expectations to guide present generation, rather than solely reacting to the past.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认为，自回归的视频原生推理需要一种前瞻性的生成视角。 我们将前瞻性推理定义为：基于观察到的历史，预测可能出现的未来结果和状态转换，并利用这种预见性来指导持续的生成过程。 这一视角揭示了两个互补的要求（图 1 (b)）。 在长程层面，模型应能预测其目标结果。 在短程层面，模型应能预测即将发生的、推动有意义进展的状态转换。 对长程结果的认知提供全局方向，而对短程转换的认知则促进向目标连贯且稳定的推进。 二者结合后，未来期望便能指导当前的生成过程，而不仅仅是被动地回应过去。

paragraphs.en: Motivated by these requirements, we propose Learning Pro spective Reasoning with A uto r egressive Video Models ( ProAR ). ProAR introduces two complementary mechanisms: (1) Outcome guidance provides explicit but sparse long-range supervision. At each autoregressive step, ProAR jointly predicts the current chunk and a goal frame representing the anticipated final state. An asymmetric attention mask prevents the current chunk from influencing the goal belief, while allowing the predicted goal to guide current generation. As the video unfolds, the model continuously updates its goal belief based on the growing history. (2) Transition guidance provides implicit and dense short-range supervision through future representation self-alignment. Leveraging teacher forcing, ProAR reuses the clean next-chunk representation computed within the same forward pass to supervise the current states to anticipate upcoming temporal dynamics. This design requires neither an external representation encoder nor an additional backbone forward pass, and the lightweight alignment predictor is removed entirely during inference. At inference, ProAR generates autoregressively without access to ground-truth future states, relying on its dynamically updated goal-frame predictions and learned anticipatory representations to guide generation.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这些需求，我们提出了“基于自回归视频模型的前景推理学习”（ProAR）。 ProAR 引入了两种互补的机制：（1）结果引导提供了明确但稀疏的长程监督。 在每个自回归步骤中，ProAR 会同时预测当前片段和一个代表预期最终状态的目标帧。 一种非对称注意力掩码可防止当前片段影响目标信念，同时允许预测的目标引导当前生成。 随着视频逐步展开，模型会根据不断积累的历史信息持续更新其目标信念。 （2）转换引导通过未来表示的自我对齐，提供了隐式且密集的短程监督。 ProAR 利用教师强制策略，在单次前向传播中复用计算出的干净下一片段表示，以监督当前状态并预测即将出现的时间动态。 这种设计既不需要外部的表示编码器，也不需要额外的主干网络前向传播，并且在推理阶段会完全移除轻量级的对齐预测器。 在推理阶段，ProAR 无需访问真实未来状态即可进行自回归生成，它依赖动态更新的目标帧预测和已学习的预测性表示来指导生成过程。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate ProAR on 13 visual reasoning tasks, including a 10-task subset of VBVR ( Wang et al., 2026a ) covering perceptual and spatial reasoning, and 3 abstract reasoning tasks from VideoRLVR ( Zhu et al., 2026b ) . Compared with standard AR generation, ProAR raises the mean score on the 10-task VBVR subset from 0.663 to 0.801, and the average success rate on VideoRLVR from 50.97 to 52.97. Ablation studies further demonstrate that Outcome and Transition guidance provide complementary gains across these tasks. ProAR is also highly training-efficient: on the 10-task VBVR subset, it surpasses the fully trained AR baseline using only 25% of the training steps. Moreover, ProAR demonstrates promising generalization to embodied reasoning, delivering consistent improvements on the WorldArena simulation benchmark ( Shang et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are threefold: (1) We revisit autoregressive video generation from a reasoning perspective, identifying the lack of prospective guidance as a key limitation of next-chunk prediction. (2) We propose ProAR, which combines goal belief and future representation self-alignment to provide outcome and transition guidance with minimal overhead. (3) Experiments across diverse video reasoning tasks demonstrate the complementary benefits of outcome and transition, driving consistent improvements in both reasoning performance and training efficiency, with promising generalization to embodied reasoning.

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive video models generate frames or chunks causally, making them suitable for long, streaming, and interactive generation. Recent methods improve scalability ( Teng et al., 2025 ) , efficiency ( Yang et al., 2025a ; Chen et al., 2026c ) , and training stability ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Cui et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026a ) during autoregressive rollout. Several studies have explored richer future information beyond next-chunk prediction through foresight alignment ( Yu et al., 2026 ) , hierarchical denoising ( Qian et al., 2026 ) , and future-aware training ( Xu et al., 2026a ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . These advances have also enabled interactive world models and world action models for embodied agents ( Bruce et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2026c ; Wang et al., 2026c ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . However, extending the prediction horizon alone can improve visual quality, but is insufficient for task-oriented generation which requires both a clear target and effective intermediate transitions. We address these needs with complementary outcome and transition guidance.

paragraphs.en: Recent studies have begun to treat video generation as a paradigm for reasoning rather than only visual synthesis ( Tong et al., 2026 ; Wiedemer et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2026 ; Qi et al., 2026 ) . Video generators can perform visual reasoning by generating intermediate solution steps, such as navigating a maze or moving pieces to solve a puzzle ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Xu et al., 2026b ) . Existing approaches improve reasoning capabilities through visual prompting ( Geirhos et al., 2026 ) , test-time training ( Cheng et al., 2026 ; Jun et al., 2026 ) , explicit chains of visual thought ( Huang et al., 2025 ) , and reinforcement learning ( Zhu et al., 2026b ; Xu et al., 2026b ) . Other studies further investigate how reasoning capabilities emerge in video generation models ( Wang et al., 2026b ; Chen et al., 2026a ) . However, most of these methods build on bidirectional generators that jointly denoise all frames and allow dense interactions across time. Autoregressive models instead strictly enforce causal generation, committing to each chunk without seeing future frames or revising past errors. The closest work in this setting ( Qian et al., 2026 ) introduces hierarchical coarse-to-fine denoising for autoregressive video reasoning. In contrast, ProAR provides lightweight outcome and transition guidance without changing the basic chunk-wise generation process.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究开始将视频生成视为一种推理范式，而不仅仅是视觉合成（Tong 等，2026；Wiedemer 等，2025；He 等，2026；Qi 等，2026）。 视频生成器可以通过生成中间解决方案步骤来进行视觉推理，例如在迷宫中导航或移动棋子以解决谜题（Wang 等，2026a；Xu 等，2026b）。 现有方法通过视觉提示（Geirhos 等，2026）、测试时训练（Cheng 等，2026；Jun 等，2026）、显式的视觉思维链（Huang 等，2025）以及强化学习（Zhu 等，2026b；Xu 等，2026b）来增强推理能力。 其他研究进一步探讨了推理能力如何在视频生成模型中涌现（Wang 等，2026b；Chen 等，2026a）。 然而，这些方法大多基于双向生成器，它们会联合去除所有帧的噪声，并允许跨时间步的密集交互。 相反，自回归模型严格遵循因果生成机制，在确定每个生成片段时不会看到未来帧或修正过去的错误。 在此设定中最相关的工作（Qian 等，2026）为自回归视频推理引入了分层粗到细的降噪方法。 相比之下，ProAR 在不改变基本的按片段生成流程的前提下，提供了轻量级的结果和过渡引导。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models learn rich semantic and structural features in their intermediate layers ( Tang et al., 2023 ; Luo et al., 2023 ) . One line of work aligns generative representations with strong pretrained feature spaces ( Oquab et al., 2023 ; He et al., 2022 ; Assran et al., 2023 ) to improve training efficiency and generation quality ( Yu et al., 2024 ; Tian et al., 2026 ; Leng et al., 2025 ) . Another line derives supervision from the generative model itself, using stronger internal representations to guide weaker ones ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Haghighi et al., 2026 ; Chefer et al., 2026 ) . Recently, representation alignment has also been explored in video post-training ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2026 ) . Most relatedly, Video-Mirai ( Yu et al., 2026 ) distills future bidirectional representations into autoregressive causal features but requires an additional forward pass. In contrast, our Transition module exploits autoregressive training properties to obtain clean future representations within the model, requiring neither an external representation encoder nor an additional model pass.

paragraphs.en: In this section, we present ProAR, a novel framework for learning prospective reasoning in autoregressive video generation. We first investigate why local next-chunk supervision is insufficient to ensure goal completion and valid progression (Sec. 3.1 ). ProAR addresses this gap through two complementary mechanisms. Outcome guidance provides explicit, sparse supervision by anchoring generation with an evolving goal belief (Sec. 3.2 ), while Transition guidance provides implicit, dense supervision by encouraging every current representation to anticipate the next stage (Sec. 3.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们介绍了 ProAR——一种用于在自回归视频生成中学习前瞻性推理的新框架。 我们首先探讨了为何局部下一片段监督不足以确保目标完成和有效推进（第 3.1 节）。 ProAR 通过两种互补的机制解决了这一问题。 结果引导通过以不断演化的目标信念锚定生成过程，提供明确而稀疏的监督（第 3.2 节）；而转换引导则通过促使每个当前表示预测下一阶段，提供隐式且密集的监督（第 3.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: We adopt teacher-forcing during training. All target chunks are denoised in parallel within a single forward pass, while a causal attention mask ensures each noisy chunk is conditioned only on its clean ground-truth history. During inference, the model generates chunks sequentially and appends each to the history for subsequent prediction. Thus, training provides chunk-level denoising supervision, whereas inference proceeds as an irreversible rollout over model-generated history.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在训练过程中采用教师强制法。 所有目标片段在一次前向传播中并行去噪，同时因果注意力掩码确保每个含噪片段仅以其干净的真实历史为条件。 在推理阶段，模型按顺序生成片段，并将每个片段追加到历史中用于后续预测。 因此，训练提供了片段级的去噪监督，而推理则作为对模型生成历史的不可逆展开进行。

paragraphs.en: Video-native reasoning requires each generated video to complete a specified task. This imposes two requirements beyond visual plausibility: (1) goal completion , where the final state must satisfy the task objective, and (2) progression validity , where intermediate transitions must follow task logic or physical constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 视频原生推理要求每个生成的视频都必须完成一项指定的任务。 这除了视觉上的合理性之外，还提出了两项要求：（1）目标达成，即最终状态必须满足任务目标；以及（2）过程有效性，即中间转换必须遵循任务逻辑或物理约束。

paragraphs.en: Recent studies show that intermediate hidden states of diffusion models encode rich semantic and temporal abstractions, and that stronger hidden states can guide weaker ones to improve generation ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Haghighi et al., 2026 ) . Building on this insight, we construct a self-supervised Teacher–Student mechanism within the backbone feature space.
paragraphs.zh: 近期研究表明，扩散模型的中层隐藏状态编码了丰富的语义和时序抽象信息，而更强的隐藏状态可以引导较弱的隐藏状态，从而提升生成效果（Jiang 等，2025；Haghighi 等，2026）。 基于这一发现，我们在主干特征空间中构建了一种自监督的教师-学生机制。

sents.en: Building on this insight, we construct a self-supervised Teacher–Student mechanism within the backbone feature space.
sents.zh: 基于这一发现，我们在主干特征空间中构建了一种自监督的教师-学生机制。

paragraphs.en: Our core idea is to use the clean representation of the next chunk to guide the noisy representation of the current chunk, as illustrated in Fig. 2 (c). The clean next-chunk hidden states contain uncontaminated information about the next stage and therefore serve as a strong, prospective teacher . In contrast, the noisy current hidden states contain incomplete and noise-corrupted information, serving as the weaker student . Thus, the teacher provides not only a cleaner representation but also a short-range temporal direction for the current state.

paragraphs.en: A key advantage of our design is that both Teacher and Student hidden states are obtained from the same backbone forward pass. paragraphs.en: (1) VBVR. VBVR ( Wang et al., 2026a ) contains 100 tasks, each with 10K training examples. paragraphs.en: Table 1 summarizes performance across the selected 10 perceptual and spatial reasoning tasks. Consistent with the short-horizon limitation discussed in Sec. 3.1 , the teacher-forced Standard AR baseline achieves a mean score of 0.663, below the 0.736 obtained by bidirectional Wan2.2 SFT. With prospective guidance, ProAR raises the mean score to 0.801, a 20.8% relative improvement over Standard AR. It also exceeds the closed-source Seedance 2.0 and Wan2.2 SFT baselines by 0.174 and 0.065, respectively. At the task level, ProAR outperforms Standard AR on 8 of the 10 tasks, with particularly large absolute gains on Stable Sort (+0.330), Pipe Puzzle (+0.122), and Slide Puzzle (+0.543). The gains across tasks with different objectives indicate that the improvement is not driven by a single reasoning pattern. Overall, these results show that prospective guidance effectively reduces the mismatch between local chunk prediction and reasoning task completion.

paragraphs.en: Table 3 reports results on the 3 abstract reasoning games. Surprisingly, Standard AR already outperforms both bidirectional Wan2.2 SFT and its reinforcement-learning variant, suggesting that causal generation is well suited to structured tasks involving sequential state transitions. Building on this strong baseline, ProAR improves the average success rate from 50.97 to 52.97 and the average precision from 61.56 to 67.17. paragraphs.en: As illustrated in Fig. 3 , ProAR overcomes the short-sighted failures of standard AR by consistently ensuring valid progression and successful goal completion. paragraphs.en: We next examine whether prospective guidance improves training efficiency in addition to final performance. Fig. 4 compares ProAR with the standard AR baseline at matched training checkpoints on VBVR 10-task subset. ProAR converges substantially faster. After only 2,500 steps, it reaches a mean score of 0.708, already exceeding the 0.663 obtained by the standard AR baseline after 10,000 steps. After Transition guidance is activated at step 7,500, the score further increases from 0.7666 to 0.8010 by step 10,000. Overall, these results show that prospective guidance improves both convergence speed and final reasoning performance without requiring additional optimization steps.

paragraphs.en: To isolate the contribution of each component, we evaluate ProAR with only outcome guidance ( w/ Outcome ) or transition guidance ( w/ Transition ) in Tables 1 and 3 . On VBVR, outcome and transition individually improve the mean score of Standard AR from 0.663 to 0.786 and 0.683, respectively, while their combination further increases it to 0.801. A similar trend appears on VideoRLVR: Outcome and Transition raise the average precision from 61.56 to 64.82 and 63.50, whereas the complete ProAR reaches 67.17. Overall, ProAR achieves the best aggregate performance on both benchmarks, leading among the AR variants on 7 of the 10 VBVR tasks and 8 of the 12 VideoRLVR metrics. These results show that long-range outcome awareness and short-range transition anticipation provide distinct and complementary guidance.

paragraphs.en: We investigate when to activate the transition module during training in Table 2 . Applying transition alignment throughout training from scratch (Step 0) yields comparable or slightly inferior performance to activating it at a later stage (Step 7500). We hypothesize that, early in training, the backbone has not yet developed stable representations for the target reasoning domain, making its internal teacher targets less informative. A task-specific fine-tuning warm-up allows more reliable, task-relevant structure to emerge before self-alignment begins. We therefore adopt the late-start strategy as the default configuration in all main experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在表 2 中研究了在训练期间何时激活转换模块。 从头开始在整个训练过程中应用转换对齐（步骤 0），其性能与在较晚阶段（步骤 7500）激活该模块相当，或略逊一筹。 我们推测，在训练的早期阶段，主干网络尚未为目标推理领域形成稳定的表示，这使得其内部教师目标的信息量较少。 针对特定任务的微调预热，可以在自我对齐开始之前，让更可靠且与任务相关的结构得以形成。 因此，我们在所有主要实验中都采用延迟启动策略作为默认配置。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we present ProAR, a novel framework that equips autoregressive video generation with prospective reasoning capability. To address the short-sightedness of next-chunk prediction, ProAR combines outcome guidance for goal completion with transition guidance for valid intermediate progression. Experiments across perceptual, spatial, abstract, and embodied reasoning benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements with modest computational overhead. These results highlight prospective modeling as a promising direction for advancing video-native reasoning, opening new possibilities for physical and embodied intelligence.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 ProAR——一个为自回归视频生成赋予前瞻性推理能力的创新框架。 为解决下一片段预测的短视问题，ProAR 将目标完成的成果引导与有效中间进展的过渡引导相结合。 在感知、空间、抽象和具身推理基准上的实验表明，该方法在计算开销不大的情况下实现了稳定的性能提升。 这些结果凸显了前瞻性建模作为推动视频原生推理发展的一个有前景方向，并为物理和具身智能开辟了新的可能性。

paragraphs.en: WorldArena ( Shang et al., 2026 ) evaluates video world models as embodied simulators across 50 RoboTwin 2.0 tasks ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . Since the original trajectory lengths vary substantially, we follow the FlowWAM ( Chen et al., 2026b ) protocol to standardize the training data: each video is uniformly sampled to 121 frames and resized to 640 × 480 640\times 480 resolution. For evaluation, WorldArena introduces 1,000 newly generated test trajectories (20 per task) beyond the official RoboTwin dataset. Following WorldArena’s default configuration, we generate these test videos in the identical 121-frame and 640 × 480 640\times 480 format. This ensures structural consistency between training and inference while preserving the complete physical manipulation process. Given these longer videos, we use a chunk size of 8 and set λ goal = 0.25 \lambda_{\mathrm{goal}}=0.25 and λ align = 0.05 \lambda_{\mathrm{align}}=0.05 . We train for 10000 steps and start the transition module at step 7000.

paragraphs.en: We first validate the asymmetric attention design introduced in Sec. 3.2 . As shown in Table 5 , removing the mask allows unrestricted interaction between the noisy current chunk and the noisy goal tokens. Our asymmetric design achieves a slightly higher mean score, improving from 0.799 to 0.801, and performs better on 6 of the 10 tasks. paragraphs.en: This section details the reasoning tasks and evaluation protocols used for VBVR and VideoRLVR.
paragraphs.zh: 本节详细说明了用于 VBVR 和 VideoRLVR 的推理任务与评估协议。

paragraphs.en: Tables 8 and 9 summarize the reasoning tasks used in our experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 表8和表9总结了我们在实验中使用的推理任务。

paragraphs.en: We follow the official evaluation protocols of VBVR and VideoRLVR.
paragraphs.zh: 我们遵循 VBVR 和 VideoRLVR 的官方评估协议。

paragraphs.en: For VBVR ( Wang et al., 2026a ) , task-specific rule-based evaluators assess the generated video against its reference solution and task objective. Depending on the task, they measure final-state correctness, object and spatial consistency, transition validity, and rule compliance. Each video receives a continuous score in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , where a higher value indicates greater task completion. This score should not be interpreted as a binary success rate.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 VBVR（Wang 等人，2026a），任务特定的规则评估器会根据参考解决方案和任务目标来评估生成的视频。 根据具体任务，它们会衡量最终状态的正确性、物体与空间的一致性、过渡的有效性以及规则合规性。 每个视频都会获得一个位于 [0,1] 的连续分数，其中数值越高表示任务完成度越高。 该分数不应被解释为二元的成功率。

paragraphs.en: For VideoRLVR ( Zhu et al., 2026b ) , we report Precision, Recall, F1, and Success Rate (SR), macro-averaged over the test samples. F1 is the harmonic mean of the per-sample Precision and Recall. The task-specific metrics are defined as follows. For Maze , Precision and Recall measure the overlap between the generated and reference path regions, while SR requires a connected path from start to goal without corrupting the maze walls. For FlowFree , Precision and Recall measure the color correctness and coverage of filled non-endpoint cells. SR additionally requires valid non-overlapping paths, preserved endpoints, correct color connectivity, and sufficient grid coverage. For Sokoban , Precision and Recall compare the generated and reference action sequences at corresponding steps. SR requires all boxes to reach their targets through sufficiently valid state transitions.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 VideoRLVR（Zhu 等人，2026b），我们报告了精确率、召回率、F1 和成功率（SR），这些指标均对测试样本进行了宏平均。 F1 是每样本精确率和召回率的调和平均值。 任务特定的指标定义如下。 对于 Maze，精确率和召回率衡量生成路径区域与参考路径区域的重叠程度，而 SR 要求从起点到终点存在一条连通的路径，且不能破坏迷宫墙壁。 对于 FlowFree，精确率和召回率衡量已填充的非端点单元格的颜色正确性和覆盖范围。 SR 还要求路径有效且不重叠、端点保持完整、颜色连通性正确，并且网格覆盖充分。 对于 Sokoban，精确率和召回率比较生成动作序列与参考动作序列在对应步骤上的差异。 SR 要求所有箱子通过足够有效的状态转换到达其目标位置。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 10 , ProAR achieves an EWMScore of 60.95, ranking first among the autoregressive models and second across all evaluated systems. paragraphs.en: While ProAR establishes a powerful paradigm for video-native reasoning, our current implementation of Outcome guidance relies on a simple heuristic: utilizing the final video frame to represent the target outcome. This design choice is highly effective for most goal-oriented reasoning tasks, where the final frame naturally encapsulates the goal completion state.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 ProAR 为视频原生推理建立了一种强大的范式，但我们目前对结果引导的实现依赖于一个简单的启发式方法：利用最后一帧视频来表示目标结果。 对于大多数以目标为导向的推理任务而言，这种设计选择非常有效，因为在这些任务中，最后一帧自然地包含了目标完成的状态。

paragraphs.en: A promising direction for future work is to transition from a fixed final-frame target to adaptive milestone guidance. Rather than strictly anchoring to the last frame, future frameworks could dynamically detect the most salient keyframes or critical bottleneck states within the visual sequence, utilizing them as flexible goals or intermediate subgoals. This would further generalize prospective reasoning to more open-ended and complex physical environments.
